verdict.rationale: Resend documents its own bulk capability: a batch endpoint that sends up to 100 emails per request, plus broadcasts sent to audience segments. Bulk operations are only evidenced for sending email, and each batch request is capped at 100 messages. Missing for 10: bulk operations on other resources (contacts, suppressions, domains, deletions or updates), batch limits or semantics beyond the 100-message cap, and independent hands-on corroboration of batch use.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: Trigger up to 100 batch emails at once.
